# nv_tc: NVIDIA-tensor-core-like DPA-16 PE and its variants (RTA / RM work, 2026-10)

RTL, reference models and testbenches of the processing element used in the RTA ("RM") study: a DPA-16 that
computes `d = c + sum_{i<16} a_i b_i` in FP32 with B200 tensor-core numerics (FP16 / BF16 / FP8 / FP4 inputs,
27-bit alignment window, truncation) and can also run as M FP32 FMA lanes ("vector mode") built from the same
multiplier tiles and alignment shifters. Synthesis results (Genus, TSMC 28 nm) are in the RTA notes, not here.

## Layout

| path | content |
|---|---|
| `dpa16/rtl/` | current PE: `dpa16_pe.sv` (PE with west / south registers, config), `dpa16_core.sv` (3-stage datapath: unpack + 16 multiplier tiles, alignment + sum, normalise), `dpa16_pkg.sv`, `dpa16_unpack.sv`, `dpa16_mul12.sv`, `dpa16_align_sum.sv`, `dpa16_norm.sv`, `dpa16_fma_back.sv` (IEEE FP32 FMA back end for `RND = 2`, bit-exact with FPnew), `dpa16_fma_lean*.sv` (stand-alone lean FP32 FMA lanes), `dpa16_pec.sv` / `dpa16_core_m.sv` / `dpa16_pe_m.sv` (combinational / multi-lane wrappers for synthesis) |
| `dpa16/rtl_array/` | 8 x 8 arrays of PEs (`dpa16_array.sv`, synthesis tops, a PE stub for routing-only runs) |
| `dpa16/rtl_x/`, `dpa16/probe/` | experiments: a hybrid lean FMA, a normaliser probe |
| `dpa16/model/` | Python references: `dpa16_ref.py` (DPA-16 numerics), `fma_win_ref.py` (27-bit window FMA), `lane_rne_ref.py`, `lane_seg_ref.py`, `ieee_fma_ref.py`, `pe_model.py`, vector generators |
| `dpa16/tb/` | VCS testbenches `tb_dpa16_core.sv`, `tb_dpa16_pe.sv`, `tb_dpa16_vec.sv`, `tb_fma_lean*.sv`, filelists and the small stimulus / expected `.hex` files (vectors above 200 KB are regenerated by `model/gen_vectors.py` and `model/gen_lanes.py`) |
| `dpa16/variants/rtl_snap_v6 .. v20` | frozen snapshots of the PE RTL as synthesised, see below |
| `dpa2_tile/` | the earlier DPA-2 MFSA-based tile (`rta_tile.sv`, weight-stationary systolic PE + vector mode) with its 8 x 8 array and testbenches |
| `simt_units/` | reference SIMT units synthesised at the same delay bounds: FPnew-numerics FP32 / FP64 FMA, window FMA (`fp32_fma_win.sv`, the lane's numerics; `_rne` variant), lean FMAs, INT32 ALU lane, MUFU lane with ROM tables |
| `syn/` | Genus case generators and result collectors (`collect_*.py`, `gen_cases_*.py`, batch scripts, wrapper templates) |

## PE parameters (`dpa16_pe.sv`)

`M` lanes of vector mode (0 = GEMM only), `PIPE` (0 = combinational core for `set_max_delay` sweeps), `ONLY`
(core hard-wired to one input format), `SHARE` (1: lanes share the adder tree as carry-save groups; 2: lane 0
rides the GEMM sum and normaliser), `RND` (0: window truncation; 1: lane 0 rounds to nearest even; 2: lane 0 is an
IEEE-754 FP32 FMA). Vector ops per lane: FMA, ADD, MUL, FNMSUB on the core, MAX / MIN / EXPADD / PASS on the aux
path; see the header of `dpa16_pe.sv`.

## Variant snapshots

The snapshots are the RTL states behind the synthesis cases (`case_dpa16_h<N>...` in the RTA notes):
v6 lanes sharing the adder tree (`SHARE = 1`), v7 / v7b / v7c lane 0 on the plain GEMM sum (`SHARE = 2`, v7c = lean
gating, the M = 1 design point), v8 RNE lane (`RND = 1`), v9 IEEE lane via `dpa16_fma_back` (`RND = 2`), v10 / v10b
lean FMA lanes (`dpa16_fma_lean*`), v11 .. v13 lane and output-format variants (BF16 / FP16 / FP8 / TF32 outputs),
v14 .. v17 INT lane integration experiments (`ilane`), v18 .. v20 the latest PE used by the RM v3 model (DPA-16 +
one FP32 lane + one INT lane + exp2). `dpa16/rtl/` is the working copy (newer than v20 where they differ).
